title: Our brand
text: Your own name, color and logo, shown to your people in the app, at your own address and in emails.
not_offered_text: {provider} does not offer an own brand for clients. Ask them if you need it.
read_only: Only people allowed to change the brand can edit it.
name: Name shown
color_hint: Used for buttons and highlights. It must be dark enough to read white text on.
contrast_text: Too light for white text on buttons.
contrast_surface: Too light to see on a white page.
logo_hint: PNG, WebP or JPEG, up to 512 KB. A wide logo on a transparent background looks best.
